clue.text: American in stout cotton stuff seen with a wife and mother of emperors

explanation.walkthrough: Livia Drusilla was the wife of Augustus and mother of Tiberius, and grandmother of Claudius, so she was wife and mother of emperors.
explanation.definitionFit: Livia Drusilla, consort of Augustus, bore Tiberius, so she was both married to one Roman ruler and parent of another.
